record.context_brief: Correlation bounds for low-degree F2 polynomials
record.original_question: Does there exist an explicit function f : F2^n -> F2, computable in NP, such that for every F2-polynomial p : F2^n -> F2 of degree at most log_2 n, the correlation satisfies |E[(-1)^<f(x), p(x)>]| <= 1/n?

evidence.quote: Statement: Find an explicit (i.e., in NP) function f : F2n -> F2 such that we have the correlation bound | E[(-1)< f ( x),p( x)> ]| <= 1/ n for every F2 -polynomial p : F2n -> F2 of degree at most log2 n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F}_2 = \{0,1\}$ denote the field with two elements. For a function $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2$ and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-polynomial $p:\mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2$ (i.e., a multilinear polynomial in $n$ variables over $\mathbb{F}_2$), define the correlation
$$\mathrm{Cor}(f,p) = \left| \mathbb{E}_{x \in \mathbb{F}_2^n}\!\left[ (-1)^{f(x) + p(x)} \right] \right|,$$
where the expectation is taken with respect to the uniform distribution on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Call a family of functions $\{f_n : \mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2\}_{n \ge 1}$ "explicit" if the language $\{(n,x) : f_n(x) = 1\}$ lies in the complexity class $\mathrm{NP}$.

Question: Does there exist an explicit family of functions $\{f_n : \mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2\}_{n \ge 1}$ such that, for every sufficiently large $n$ and every $\mathbb{F}_2$-polynomial $p: \mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2$ of degree at most $\log_2 n$, one has
$$\mathrm{Cor}(f_n, p) \le \frac{1}{n}\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of exhibiting an explicit function with correlation at most $1/n$ (or even any negligible bound) against all $\mathbb{F}_2$-polynomials of degree $\log_2 n$ is widely cited as a central open problem in circuit complexity; it would imply superpolynomial lower bounds for AC^0[parity] circuits augmented with one majority gate. Recent work (e.g., Ivanov–Pavlovic–Viola, CCC 2023, and Viola's surveys) confirms that no such explicit function is currently known even for degree $\log_2 n$.

status_evidence.title: Correlation bounds against polynomials (survey)
status_evidence.snippet: No explicit function on n bits is known to have negligible correlation with GF(2) polynomials of degree log_2 n.
status_evidence.claim: The problem remains open as of recent surveys.

status_evidence.title: On correlation bounds against polynomials (Ivanov, Pavlovic, Viola, CCC 2023)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on correlation bounds; counterexamples and partial progress for low-degree polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: State of the art still does not achieve negligible correlation against degree log n polynomials by an explicit function.
